candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. E get diarrhoea wey don last for 3 days. E no dey convulse now and e never convulse before. E no dey weak or e no dey unconscious. E sabi drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. No blood dey inside stool. E no dey restless or irritable. When I pinch skin, e normal. Eye no sink. E no get cough or e no dey find am hard to breathe. E no get ear wahala. E no get fever.
